# CATHAREi Bakery & Sweets

Bakery in Qatar with branches in Doha (Salwa Road), Al Wakrah and Al Kharaitiyat.

- [Menu](https://www.catharei.com/menu.html): sweets, cakes and savouries
- [Arabic sweets](https://www.catharei.com/navigation/Arabic_sweets.html)
- [Custom cakes](https://www.catharei.com/navigation/customized_cakes.html)
- [Contact and branches](https://www.catharei.com/contact.html)
- [Delivery](https://www.catharei.com/delivery.html): confirm coverage and timing with the branch
- [Catering](https://www.catharei.com/catering.html)
- [Corporate gifting](https://www.catharei.com/corporate-gifting.html)
- [Blog](https://www.catharei.com/blog)

كاثاري للحلويات والكيك والمعجنات في قطر. الفروع: الدوحة والوكرة والخريطيات.
